title: Medical Game Generic Drug Name Catalog
purpose: Passive generic-name recognition and class browsing for an educational game. Recognition is separate from clinical answer correctness.

scope.coverage: Broad ATC-mapped RxNorm ingredient, precise-ingredient and combination catalog, supplemented by selected study medicines. Includes common, specialist, regional and legacy entries. Not an exhaustive global formulary.
scope.market_status: Not assessed. An active terminology concept does not establish current marketing, human prescribing availability or suitability in a given country.
not_included: Every new or locally available medicine
scope.classification_caveat: An ingredient may have multiple ATC memberships depending on use and formulation; browsing membership must never make drugs interchangeable for grading.
scope.snapshot_notice: Dated terminology snapshot; it does not automatically track later source updates.

owner_decisions.question: How should this be integrated?
options: Read-only dictionary adapter to the existing validator
Separate experimental branch for review
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Read-only dictionary adapter to the existing validator

owner_decisions.question: When should spelling suggestions appear?
options: After Submit only
While typing

owner_decisions.question: How should plausible misspellings be handled?
options: Ask the player to confirm every correction
Automatically normalize only unique minor typos after explicit approval
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Ask the player to confirm every correction

owner_decisions.question: Which spelling tolerance should be tried?
options: Conservative: 1 edit for 5-7 letters; up to 2 for 8+ with similarity >= 0.80
Stricter: one edit for all names of 5+ letters
Custom threshold to be tested
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Conservative: 1 edit for 5-7 letters; up to 2 for 8+ with similarity >= 0.80

owner_decisions.question: Which vocabulary should provide suggestions?
options: Entire game/course vocabulary, with all catalog names still recognized exactly
Full catalog including specialist and historical entries
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Entire game/course vocabulary, with all catalog names still recognized exactly

owner_decisions.question: Accept verified international generic synonyms?
options: Yes, mapped to the same catalog identity
Show the variant and ask the player to confirm
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Yes, mapped to the same catalog identity

owner_decisions.question: Which generic naming convention should be shown?
options: Keep the existing game convention
Prefer international or UK names
Prefer RxNorm or US names

owner_decisions.question: How should salts, formulations, prodrugs and insulin types be treated?
options: Keep separate; question-specific equivalence only
Review specified equivalences individually

owner_decisions.question: How should multi-ingredient answers be entered?
options: Recognize all components with + or /; allow reversed component order after approval
Require the stored written order until reviewed
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Recognize all components with + or /; allow reversed component order after approval

owner_decisions.question: How should abbreviations be handled?
options: Keep existing explicit abbreviation mappings only
Review additional abbreviations one by one
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Keep existing explicit abbreviation mappings only

owner_decisions.question: What happens to the timer and attempt count while confirmation is open?
options: Pause timer and do not consume an attempt for spelling-only confirmation
Keep the existing timing behavior; explain its consequences
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Pause timer and do not consume an attempt for spelling-only confirmation

owner_decisions.question: How should an unresolved name be handled?
options: Keep input editable and request clarification before grading
Use the existing unknown-answer workflow
owner_decisions.suggested_starting_point: Keep input editable and request clarification before grading

matching_design.status: Proposed design, not active configuration. Reference module is optional and does not alter any game.
normalization: Normalize Unicode dash variants; preserve digits, meaningful tokens and hyphens
matching_design.exact_match_precedence: Check the entire dictionary before any fuzzy lookup. A real but wrong drug remains that drug.
matching_design.aliases: Only drug.aliases are accepted lexical synonyms; atc_mappings.source_name and related_ingredient_ids are reference data, not automatic synonyms.
matching_design.fuzzy_algorithm: Adjacent-transposition-aware edit distance (optimal string alignment), proposed thresholds subject to approval and testing.
matching_design.abbreviations: None added by this catalog; preserve explicit existing game rules and ask before expanding them.
matching_design.unsupported_input: Request clarification; do not invent a drug or force a nearest neighbor.
